# Verovo

> Know what your AI agents spent, whether the bill is right, and whether the spend was worth it. Verovo tracks AI spend, audits charges independently, prepares line-level buyer actions, and compares costs with verified task outcomes. Real-time control and causal contribution remain separate roadmap work.

OVO family boundary: Prove Anything is the family-level result-proof protocol candidate; an agent saying “done” remains a claim to verify. Verified Capability Factory is a gated research candidate, not a Verovo dependency. Verovo stays buyer-first and is not becoming a generalized verification platform; charges, delivery, coverage and buyer decisions remain separate.

## Start here

- [Website](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/): overview and local quickstart
- Period proof: `verovo proof export --bundle PERIOD --out NEW_DIR --by NAME`, then `verovo proof replay NEW_DIR --bundle PERIOD`; replay verifies input hashes and recomputes canonical output, returns EXPIRED on changed inputs, and never modifies either directory.
- [Services](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/services.html): free measurement-run scope, inputs and turnaround
- [FAQ（中文）](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/faq.html): Chinese answers to common queries (AI bill checking, API cost recount, open-source reconciliation tools, AI-support billing disputes) with sourced numbers; FAQPage structured data
- Task-spend forecast: `verovo monitor forecast --state STATE --contract FORECAST_JSON`; explicit task/currency/period/progress evidence, linear observed-cost-per-completed-unit estimate, null on missing data, and no budget-cap or final-bill claim. MCP action `monitor_forecast`.
- [Tool bill coverage](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/tools.html): cataloged tool billing models for buyer tasks; provider work is a conditional extension. Cataloged is not live-validated.
- [Healthcheck](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/healthcheck/README.md): local session checks, sharing and supported commands; install from PyPI `pipx install verovo`
- Two CLI lines: `verovo` (installed wheel) is the buyer-facing entry for healthcheck, canonical finance and canonical Proof. `python3 -m buyer_ledger` (close/reproduce) is a pre-M1 source-checkout tool line and is not shipped in the wheel.
- Version lines are independent: the product release in `CHANGELOG.md` and the `healthcheck` package `__version__` do not have to match; check both before citing a capability.
- [SDK](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/sdk/README.md): Provider SDK `@verovo/mcp` on npm, independently versioned
- [Release notes](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/releases.html): independent package versions and dated releases
- [AI invoice reconciliation](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/blog/ai-invoice-reconciliation.html): three-step method, seven failure modes and a free browser recount; the reproducible sample lives in `buyer-ledger/examples/ai-invoice-reconciliation`
- [AI spend optimization method](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/blog/ai-spend-optimization.html): separate Monitoring, Control, Audit and Optimization; calculate cost per verified success; use tool removal, replacement and replay before claiming incremental contribution. `tool-value` includes Wilson/Newcombe 95% intervals and explicit selection-bias limits; intervals do not automatically select a tool winner.
- Post-optimization review: `verovo optimize-verify --baseline TASKS --final TASKS --contract REVIEW_JSON`; compare observed cost per task/success and quality guardrails for keep/rollback/inconclusive advice; non-overlapping ordered windows and change effective time are required for keep, with no causal or realized-invoice-saving claim and no automatic rollback.
- Advisory budget signal: `verovo budget check --state MONITOR_STATE --budget BUDGET_JSON`; explicit scope/period/thresholds produce `allow/warn/hold/review`, with no cross-currency sum and no claim that external control was applied.
- Stop-readback reconciliation: `verovo budget verify --state MONITOR_STATE --decision DECISION_JSON --receipt RECEIPT_JSON`; binds budget/action/scope, a stopped runtime readback and complete subsequent-spend coverage. Positive post-stop charges fail and credits cannot hide them; incomplete evidence stays UNPROVABLE. Local consistency is not external-record authenticity or runtime contact. MCP action `budget_verify`.
- Spend time series: `verovo monitor series --state STATE --granularity minute|hour|day`; UTC half-open windows, task/tool/model scope, per-currency amounts and retry counts, UNKNOWN separate, no cross-currency total or final-bill claim. MCP action `monitor_series`.
- Named budget recovery: `verovo budget resume --state STATE --budget BUDGET --recovery RECOVERY --out HISTORY_JSONL`; current allow/warn plus named confirmation and running runtime readback are required. Spend is preserved, history is deduplicated, hold/review cannot be overridden, and no external runtime is contacted. MCP action `budget_resume`.
- Persistent monitoring: `verovo monitor freeze-baseline --file USAGE --state STATE`, then `verovo monitor track --file USAGE --state STATE`; deduplicated records, frozen baseline, late-record handling and anomaly history remain advisory only. `verovo monitor notify --state STATE --out ALERTS_JSONL` appends deduplicated active anomalies as `pending_local_delivery`; no external notification or host wake-up is performed. `verovo monitor resolution --file ALERTS_JSONL --alert ALERT_ID` emits `ovo.problem-resolution/1` without executing a fix; evaluate it with `python3 -m ovo_acceptance resolution FILE`.
- Human alternative baseline: `verovo human-baseline --human HUMAN_TASKS --agent AGENT_TASKS --contract CONTRACT`; equal task/quality/currency contracts, direct cost plus declared human-minute cost, quality guardrails and unknown zero-success denominators. Descriptive and unreconciled, not causal savings or procurement authorization. MCP action `human_baseline`.
- Controlled local task execution: `verovo experiment run --contract CONTROLLED_TASK_RUN --out NEW_DIR`; fresh isolated task/arm processes, named local-only authorization, timeouts, output caps and success conditions. Costs stay unknown and output directories never overwrite; no external actions or causal winner. MCP action `experiment_run`.
- Shared experiment export: `verovo tool-value-export --file TASKS --design DESIGN --out NEW_JSON`; emits task-level success/cost observations with source hashes, explicit registration and eligibility, and no automatic causal upgrade.
- Local MCP: `verovo_invoice_intake`, `verovo_period_intake`, `verovo_optimize`, `verovo_economics_ops`, `verovo_review`, `verovo_review_template`, and `verovo_recount`. `verovo_economics_ops` covers monitoring, deduplicated local alert outboxes, shared problem-resolution projection, advisory budget checks and stop-readback reconciliation, optimization review, direct tool-value analysis, and experiment export; only explicit local state/output paths are written, with no external control or automatic rollback.
- [Per-resolution bills](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/blog/resolution-bill-check.html): who attested each resolution, and how to check that bill locally

- [Core](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/standard/CORE.md): objects, grains and invariants

## Product definition and buyer review

- [Product definition](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/docs/product-definition.md): independent agent spend audit and value measurement, with separate financial, control, delivery and economic conclusions.
- [Spend action list](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/schemas/spend-action-list.schema.json): ready/evidence/review/unreviewed/settled work items from an existing Audit Case; no payment execution or authorization.
- [Provider contract](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/docs/provider-contract.md): local adapter admission, version, limits, coverage and cleanup; no live-connectivity claim.
- [Buyer review guide](https://github.com/roy-tong/Verovo/blob/main/docs/buyer-review.md): local criteria and JSON evidence; separate verdicts, hashes and offline reports.
- [Synthetic buyer report](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/examples/buyer-review.html): charge match, unmet delivery requirement and missing evidence, kept separate.
- [Replayable synthetic period](https://roy-tong.github.io/Verovo/examples/replayable-period.html): Intake → Recompute → Review → Decide, with delivery UNKNOWN and the buyer decision UNPROVEN.
- Local quickstart: `pipx install verovo && verovo review --sample --html buyer-review.html`.

## Service and evidence limits

Analysis runs locally. Sharing is a user choice after inspection. Existing sample-based measurement runs are free with their published scope. Enterprise charge/delivery reviews require a concrete task, agreed scope and any individually agreed fee; no fixed price or recovery guarantee is published. Delivery review does not require a billing error. Rule applicability and source truth require human review.

Summary counts support interpretation, not guaranteed root-cause diagnosis. Core FMT-002 does not verify token/cache semantics, invoice amounts or pricing accuracy. Missing evidence remains UNPROVABLE. Technical findings and synthetic fixtures are not customer value or paid-demand proof.
